title: Fox Company Eagle, Globe, and Anchor Ceremony B-Roll

unit: Marine Corps Recruit Depot, Parris Island
description: New Marines with Fox Company, 2nd Recruit Training Battalion, Recruit Training Regiment, are presented their Eagle, Globe and Anchor on Marine Corps Recruit Depot Parris Island, S.C., Oct. 25, 2025. The Eagle, Globe, and Anchor ceremony is the final event of the Crucible and represents the transformation from recruit to Marine. (U.S. Marine Corps video by Cpl. Jordy Morales)
